changelog.en: Add-ons without ribbon buttons (for example an engine inside a Power PDF feature) are marked in the store window, so nobody looks for a button.
changelog.de: Add-ons ohne eigene Schaltfläche (zum Beispiel eine Engine in einer Power-PDF-Funktion) sind im Store-Fenster gekennzeichnet, damit niemand nach einem Button sucht.
changelog.fr: Les modules sans bouton dans le ruban (par exemple un moteur dans une fonction de Power PDF) sont signalés dans la fenêtre du store, pour que personne ne cherche de bouton.
changelog.it: I componenti aggiuntivi senza pulsanti (ad esempio un motore in una funzione di Power PDF) sono contrassegnati nella finestra dello store, così nessuno cerca un pulsante.
changelog.es: Los complementos sin botones en la cinta (por ejemplo, un motor dentro de una función de Power PDF) se marcan en la ventana de la tienda para que nadie busque un botón.
changelog.nl: Invoegtoepassingen zonder knoppen in het lint (bijvoorbeeld een engine in een functie van Power PDF) zijn gemarkeerd in het storevenster, zodat niemand naar een knop zoekt.
changelog.pt: Os suplementos sem botões no friso (por exemplo, um motor numa função do Power PDF) são assinalados na janela da loja, para que ninguém procure um botão.
changelog.da: Tilføjelsesprogrammer uden knapper på båndet (for eksempel en motor i en Power PDF-funktion) er markeret i butiksvinduet, så ingen leder efter en knap.
changelog.fi: Lisäosat ilman valintanauhan painikkeita (esimerkiksi moottori Power PDF:n toiminnossa) on merkitty kauppaikkunaan, jottei kukaan etsi painiketta.
changelog.nb: Tillegg uten knapper på båndet (for eksempel en motor i en Power PDF-funksjon) er merket i butikkvinduet, så ingen leter etter en knapp.
changelog.sv: Tillägg utan knappar i menyfliksområdet (till exempel en motor i en Power PDF-funktion) markeras i butiksfönstret, så att ingen letar efter en knapp.
changelog.pl: Dodatki bez przycisków na wstążce (na przykład silnik w funkcji Power PDF) są oznaczone w oknie sklepu, aby nikt nie szukał przycisku.
changelog.cs: Doplňky bez tlačítek na pásu karet (například modul ve funkci Power PDF) jsou v okně obchodu označeny, aby nikdo nehledal tlačítko.
changelog.hu: A menüszalaggombok nélküli bővítmények (például egy motor egy Power PDF-funkcióban) meg vannak jelölve az áruház ablakában, hogy senki ne keressen gombot.
changelog.ru: Надстройки без кнопок на ленте (например, движок внутри функции Power PDF) отмечены в окне магазина, чтобы никто не искал кнопку.
changelog.tr: Şerit düğmesi olmayan eklentiler (örneğin bir Power PDF işlevi içindeki bir motor) mağaza penceresinde işaretlenir; böylece kimse düğme aramaz.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.
